limits: Offline integration verification; approved geography, source authority and physical classification remain unresolved. All baseline world shapes are inspected; bounded pixel domain covers full changed shapes plus halo, not the entire world. Original encoded canonical ownership partitions are not consumed in this packet; reconstructed baseline/candidate application compilation is compared, and encoded baseline verification needs a separate bounded follow-up.
Full-world geographic detector finds nine positive new overlap fragments; candidate remains blocked without area waiver.
Both baseline projections and Pakistan candidate projection retain earlier invalidity. Actual half-open rendering behavior does not repair or approve geographic shapes.
No source authority/date/crosswalk/physical-water approval, history transfer, core edit, release, provider/database changes or deployment.
Original encoded canonical partitions are excluded from this packet and remain an explicit separate verification obligation.
Raw source-coordinate area values are native planar topology diagnostics, not WGS84 physical land area or administrative ownership.

methods.description: Pinned existing full-world detector and no-threshold lost/new overlap topology; retained source-coordinate area flags are not physical land area.

methods.description: Actual pinned application even-odd rasterizer, compiler, integer packing, byte-shuffle/gzip decoding, sampling and picking for every full-shape rectangle cell; exact neighbor inventory/indices/bounds, independent multiplicity, complete RLE changes.
methods.units: integer cell counts and full-width owner/run/byte identity
